title: integration-sprint-S0-S7
universal_lens: The integration sprint formalizes a hierarchical Bayesian state-space model where raw signal ingestion is strictly decoupled from cleared inference. Projections emerge as posterior predictive distributions conditioned on joint game latent variables, enforcing point-in-time reproducibility and rigorous abstention when epistemic uncertainty exceeds calibrated thresholds.
gsi_mapping: GSI maps the truth-freeze to conformal prediction over time-partitioned validation sets. Player projections are generated via partial pooling across team/opponent hierarchies, propagating availability uncertainty into distributional outputs (quantiles, floor/ceiling). Calibration gates enforce strict reliability diagrams before any public superiority claim.
gse_mapping: GSE treats the sprint sequence as a guarded automaton. State transitions from illustrative DFS to production scoring require passing immutable evidence checks. The fail-closed governor acts as a hard constraint on the state machine, aborting predictions if source freshness or rights-clearance invariants are violated.

primitives.name: Immutable Source Snapshot Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Immutable raw SourceSnapshot plus source_as_of, fetched_at, available_at/created_at, correction lineage, parser version, raw hash, rights snapshot and license status.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: SourceSnapshot: dimensionless immutable record; source_as_of, fetched_at, available_at: ISO-8601 timestamps (s); raw_hash: cryptographic digest (dimensionless); license_status: boolean/categorical flag.
primitives.assumptions: Data sources emit discrete updates that can be cryptographically hashed and legally bounded at the moment of ingestion.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails if upstream APIs lack deterministic serialization, causing identical logical states to yield divergent raw hashes, breaking point-in-time reproducibility.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a version-controlled ledger in distributed systems, ensuring every downstream feature vector $x_t$ can be exactly reconstructed from its provenance graph.
layer2.telemetry: Hash collision rate, timestamp drift between fetched_at and available_at, percentage of sources lacking valid license snapshots.

primitives.name: Joint Latent Variable Propagator
primitives.verbatim_quote: Build model-owned projections **Why:** The current DFS surface is deterministic and transparent but its shipped slate is illustrative; production scores require a trained, persisted model.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: $y_i$: projected stat line (dimensionless count/rate); $\mathbf{x}_i$: player feature vector; $z_g$: joint game latent variable (pace/possessions, dimensionless); $\theta, \phi_i$: model parameters.
primitives.assumptions: Player performances are conditionally independent given the shared game-level latent state $z_g$, and availability follows a distinct stochastic process.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularity occurs during extreme regime shifts (e.g., lockouts, unprecedented rule changes) where historical partial pooling priors severely mis-specify the current data-generating process.

layer2.mapping: Maps directly to GSI's hierarchical Bayesian engine, deriving individual player distributions by marginalizing over correlated team dynamics and opponent constraints.
layer2.telemetry: Posterior variance of $z_g$, coverage probability of predicted quantiles against realized stats, correlation preservation between teammates.

primitives.name: Conformal Reliability Governor
primitives.verbatim_quote: Prove calibration and edge **Why:** The current state is explicitly not PROVEN and the architecture prioritizes a calibration-first head and honest abstention.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: $\mathbb{I}$: indicator function (dimensionless); $\hat{C}(x)$: predicted conformal interval; $\alpha$: target miscoverage rate (dimensionless fraction); $\epsilon$: convergence error bound.
primitives.assumptions: Exchangeability of data points within the defined calibration window; the test distribution does not shift drastically relative to the calibration set.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down under severe concept drift where the calibration set becomes entirely unrepresentative of the current sporting meta, forcing continuous recalibration or total abstention.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a safety-critical control loop in GSE, dynamically throttling prediction output based on real-time evaluation receipts and uncertainty bounds.
layer2.telemetry: Empirical miscoverage rate vs. nominal $\alpha$, abstention frequency, Brier score divergence on held-out time partitions.

reasoning_traces.think:
The transition from an illustrative DFS platform to a production-grade prediction engine requires formalizing the separation between raw signal ingestion and probabilistic inference. We begin by defining the Immutable Source Snapshot Operator, which establishes a rigorous point-in-time provenance graph. This operator ensures that for any projection $y_t$, the exact feature vector $x_t$ and its legal boundaries can be deterministically reconstructed, eliminating phantom dependencies. Building upon this frozen truth, we introduce the Joint Latent Variable Propagator. Unlike naive independent regressions, this kernel employs hierarchical partial pooling, integrating player-specific traits with dynamic game-level latents (e.g., pace, defensive pressure). Crucially, it decouples the binary availability process from per-minute production, propagating role uncertainty directly into the final distributional outputs—yielding floors, ceilings, and full quantile spectra rather than brittle point estimates. However, mathematical elegance alone does not guarantee product viability; hence, the Conformal Reliability Governor acts as the final arbiter. Operating on purged, time-ordered validation folds, this gate computes conformal prediction intervals. If the empirical miscoverage exceeds the nominal threshold $\alpha$, or if the calibration head detects high epistemic variance, the system triggers an 'honest abstention,' withholding the projection entirely. This triad of operators forms a closed-loop epistemic system: freeze the input manifold, propagate structural correlations through hierarchical Bayes, and rigorously gate the output against observed reality, ensuring that apparent sophistication never outpaces trustworthy accuracy.

reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: This architecture inherits from the foundational works of hierarchical Bayesian modeling in sports analytics (e.g., hierarchical win-bug models), merging them with modern conformal inference frameworks introduced by Vovk et al. The emphasis on point-in-time reproducibility echoes the rigorous audit trails demanded in quantitative finance, adapting ledger-based immutability to the chaotic, rights-constrained domain of live sports telemetry. Retrocausal Genealogy: Rooted in integration-sprint-S0-S7 (f9f12c26e3afaaaf), this derivation preserves strict unit consistency, explicit validity boundaries, zero-leakage temporal separation, and bounded structural integration across GSI calibration heads, spectral orthogonalization clusters, and GSE Stage-2 situational reasoning families without fabricating parameters.
reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: We model the opposing agent—the market participant or fantasy manager—as a rational actor seeking exploitable inefficiencies. By exposing our uncertainty intervals and abstention states, we preemptively neutralize their ability to exploit our blind spots. The system assumes the user will stress-test our projections; therefore, providing explicit counter-evidence and missing-data states builds a robust adversarial trust framework, transforming the product from a black-box oracle into a transparent analytical partner.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: A critical veto condition exists between the Signal Architecture and the Calibration Governor. If new high-value context signals (e.g., narrative or beat reports) are ingested without established as-of logs and bot-manipulation controls, they must be shadow-held. Introducing unverified, high-frequency noise into the feature space risks collinearity and catastrophic overfitting. The fail-closed paid-data governor enforces this veto, ensuring that expanding signal breadth never compromises the foundational integrity of the frozen truth registry.
